**Finding: compliant (GOVLAW)** — no redline proposed.

- **§ 28.1** — New York law governs the Agreement and each dispute arising from it; CISG expressly disapplied. This is our preferred governing law.
- **§ 28.2** — Exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, with irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/inconvenient-forum objections. The narrow carve-out for temporary injunctive relief elsewhere (to protect confidential information or IP) is customary and does not undercut the exclusive merits forum.
- **§ 28.3** — Pre-filing executive escalation only; it does not delay urgent relief or filings needed to preserve a limitations period, so it is not a mandatory alternative forum.
- No arbitration clause, foreign seat, or competing venue exists anywhere in the document (searches for "arbitration", "laws of", "London/England and Wales" returned nothing responsive outside § 28).

The clause meets both preferred elements, so no change is warranted.
